property_summary: Each new grant proposal stores its grant details under a fresh, sequentially increasing proposal id, so after two proposals the first and second stored grants keep their own distinct recipients and amounts; the mutant never increments proposalCount, so both proposals overwrite id 0 and ids 1 and 2 stay empty, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Remove the `proposalCount += 1;` statement so proposalCount no longer increases when a grant proposal is created.
